title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Doctor, would you like to study the languages and lifestyles of tribal Sargon with me? It'll be harder than combat training, for sure.

title: Talk 1
original: I bear a duty to my tribe, and I will see it through to the end. Tribal heritage is a pretty distant thing to a girl who grew up in Columbia, but the doubts of a few lords ameer won't discourage me!

title: Talk 2
original: Isn't Kestrel's weapon just awesome? The way she wields it is so different from any other weapon. I'd love to spar with her, to learn her style, when I get the chance.

title: Talk 3
original: Uh… thank you. I'm having a hard time getting used to this Sargonian alcohol. I miss Columbian kale soda.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: That's true. I've lost a few fights with those ameeri guards, and sometimes it wasn't even close. But there's still time, I'll get my chance.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: The padishahs and local warriors look down on Columbian composite swords, just because they're designed for urban combat. But I'll show them the potential of combining modern technology with traditional tactics someday.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Remember, it's vital to stay hydrated, Doctor. Once you spend a whole month in the wilds of Sargon, during the dry season, without seeing so much as the mirage of an oasis… you'll get it.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: At first, there weren't many tribes who believed I'm actually descended from the Qarnsayf. Can't blame them, considering how the legend has faded from history. You believed me from the start? Oh… I mean, thank you…

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: My dream is to host a martial arts tournament in Sargon, and gather all the warriors from all the lands, so they can share in the glory of the Qarnsayf. You should come too, and bring the best of Rhodes Island with you! Yeah, it's a promise, Doctor!

title: Idle
original: You can rest safely here. We're not in the wilds.

title: Onboard
original: Hello, Doctor. I'm Hadiya, descendant of the Sargonian Qarnsayf tribe. I've come to study at Rhodes Island in order to overcome the challenges that the wilds have set for me.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Sargon warriors say that combat is the way to grow, but I can learn in this way too. Let's get started.

title: Promotion 1
original: I'm still a very long way from my goal, but please accept my gratitude.

title: Promotion 2
original: You honor my tribe when you honor me. Thank you for the recognition.

title: Added to Squad
original: An opportunity to try out some new moves.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Like the wilds of Sargon, the battlefield is more dangerous than it looks. Make sure you know what you're doing.

title: Depart
original: Is your equipment ready? It all comes down to this—time to fight!

title: Begin Operation
original: Which weapon would you like to be on the receiving end of?

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: My turn, finally.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: What tactics do you want me to use?

title: Deployment 1
original: I hope it's a worthy foe.

title: Deployment 2
original: Do you know what these horns signify?

title: In Battle 1
original: In the name of the Qarnsayf!

title: In Battle 2
original: In the name of the wilds!

title: In Battle 3
original: I have more than one weapon.

title: In Battle 4
original: Take this!

title: 4-star Result
original: I always knew I would win a memorable victory someday.

title: 3-star Result
original: Victories like these are what Sargonian warriors live for.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: No, I can't be content with the limitations of my sword. For the sake of my tribe.

title: Operation Failure
original: Defeat is but the herald of victory. Let's pull back for now.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Ah… It's been a long time since I've had a solid roof over my head.

title: Tap
original: Be careful, or my horns might hurt you.

title: Trust Tap
original: Curious about my sword? Here, try it out. Oh, and be careful about the spring blade in the staff.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year, Doctor. How would you like to celebrate the holiday? Are we going with Sargonian tradition, or Columbian custom, or do you have some other arrangement in mind? Either way, I'm with you.

title: Greeting
original: What challenge do you have for me today, Doctor?

title: Birthday
original: Today is your birthday, and I think it would do you good to set work aside for a while and go out for a walk. The landscapes of Sargon are spectacular, but you didn't seem to have time for them. Come, consider today's excursion my gift to you.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Looks like we're both a step closer to our goal. Let's celebrate this with a Columbian high-five! We've got a long way to go in the days to come.
